title: Microsoft Teams: organisation-wide meeting and call troubleshooting in the Teams admin center
summary: Hold: the briefing treats Administrative Unit scoping as unconfirmed even though Microsoft's prerequisites explicitly scope access to users' meetings. The paths, commands and rollout facts are supported, but the description of the experience as read-only also goes beyond the sources.

claims.claim: The notice includes participant issue details.
claims.quote: Issue details: Quickly identify issues experienced by participants and access additional details.

claims.claim: The notice includes detailed telemetry and diagnostics.
claims.quote: Detailed diagnostics: Drill down into telemetry and diagnostic information to support root cause analysis and troubleshooting.

claims.claim: Learn describes interconnected user, meeting and participant views.
claims.quote: User view - Shows a user's meeting history alongside weekly quality and activity trends. ... Meeting view - Shows the details of a specific meeting ... Participant view - Shows session-level telemetry and diagnostics for a specific participant in a meeting.

claims.claim: The cited Learn article does not document the organisation-wide Meetings & Calls > Meetings route.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams admin center Meetings & Calls roles Administrative Units organization monitoring. Opened monitor-troubleshoot-teams-meetings-calls in full; its navigation steps start at Manage users, not the notice's organisation-wide route.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Good and Poor quality labels have been replaced by quality or reliability issue indications.
claims.quote: Meeting and call quality is no longer categorized as Good or Poor. Instead, you can now check if the user faced any quality or reliability issues in the meeting.

claims.claim: Completed-meeting quality is judged using intelligent media classifiers after telemetry aggregation.
claims.quote: Once a meeting is complete and the telemetry is aggregated, media quality is judged using intelligent media classifiers.

claims.claim: A highlighted telemetry value does not necessarily mean poor user experience.
claims.quote: A value being highlighted doesn't necessarily mean the user experienced poor quality, but can help identify potential risks worth additional investigation.

claims.claim: An in-progress issue does not necessarily mean the user experienced degraded quality.
claims.quote: Since these values are general targets based on expected performance, the existence of an issue doesn't necessarily mean the user experienced degraded media quality.

claims.claim: Participant details include username and licence type.
claims.quote: Username and license type

claims.quote: Searched: Teams admin center export meeting data permissions; Teams admin center Meetings export audit permissions disable monitoring troubleshooting. Opened troubleshooting and Teams roles pages; no separate export permission setting documented for this experience.

claims.claim: GDAP partner admins need Teams Communications Support Specialist or Teams Communications Support Engineer in the customer tenant.
claims.quote: Partner admins using Granular Delegated Admin Privileges (GDAP) must be assigned the Teams Communications Support Specialist (TCSS) or Teams Communications Support Engineer (TCSE) role in the customer tenant.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Administrative Unit assignment scopes which users' meetings an administrator can access.
claims.quote: If your organization uses Administrative Units (AUs), your AU assignment determines which users' meetings you can access.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not said how Administrative Unit scoping applies to the new organisation-wide lists.
claims.quote: If your organization uses Administrative Units (AUs), your AU assignment determines which users' meetings you can access.
claims.fix: Remove 'Microsoft has not said how that scoping applies to the new organisation-wide lists; confirm it before relying on it to limit visibility.' Keep the preceding sentence about Administrative Units scoping access: Learn states that prerequisite for the troubleshooting experience without a list-specific exception.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The sources describe a read-only experience with no change to autonomy or actions.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams admin center meetings troubleshooting read-only callRecords. Opened troubleshooting and Teams roles articles; read MC1462463. They describe monitoring, diagnostics, exports and Copilot analysis, but do not guarantee read-only behaviour.
claims.fix: Replace 'No change: the sources describe a read-only monitoring and troubleshooting view.' with 'The sources describe monitoring, diagnostics and Copilot analysis.' In the risk rationale replace 'a read-only view of meeting and call telemetry' with 'a view of meeting and call telemetry'.

claims.claim: Troubleshoot opens Copilot in a chat window with a prefilled prompt that the administrator runs.
claims.quote: Copilot opens in a chat window within the Teams admin center with a prefilled prompt. Just run the prompt and Copilot provides a detailed analysis of the user's experience in the meeting.

claims.claim: In-progress meetings were previously shown under Recent meetings.
claims.quote: In-progress meetings list (earlier these meetings showed up as "Recent meetings")

claims.claim: Completed meetings were previously shown under Recent meetings or Past meetings.
claims.quote: Completed meetings list (earlier these meetings showed up as both "Recent meetings" and "Past meetings" depending on user license and elapsed time).

claims.claim: Completed-meeting telemetry processing can take 30 minutes to 2 hours after the meeting ends.
claims.quote: Once the meeting has ended, it might take from 30 minutes to 2 hours for the telemetry to be processed.

claims.claim: Learn's prerequisites list roles, AU assignment where used, GDAP roles and Teams use, without naming an administrator licence.
claims.quote: You have one of the supported admin roles assigned in Microsoft Entra ID.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Scope; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Meeting troubleshooting data is available for all Teams users regardless of licence type, including in-progress data while live.
claims.quote: Meeting troubleshooting data (real-time granular and aggregate) is available for all Teams users regardless of license type.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Telemetry depth and retention vary by licence.
claims.quote: However, the depth and retention period of telemetry data varies by license.

claims.claim: Teams Premium and Teams Rooms Pro accounts retain real-time telemetry for seven days after the meeting ends.
claims.quote: Real-time telemetry is available for users and accounts with Teams Premium and Teams Rooms Pro licenses for seven days after the meeting ends.

claims.claim: Other users retain real-time telemetry for the duration of the meeting.
claims.quote: For all other users, the real-time telemetry is retained for the duration of the meeting.
claims.fix: Keep the cited current-experience statement, but add: 'The older real-time telemetry article instead says users without Teams Premium retain real-time telemetry for 24 hours.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/use-real-time-telemetry-to-troubleshoot-poor-meeting-quality#where-to-find-per-user-real-time-troubleshooting-telemetry for that differing statement.

claims.claim: Aggregated telemetry is available for all users for 30 days after the meeting ends.
claims.quote: Aggregated telemetry is available for all users for 30 days after the meeting ends.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost

claims.claim: The licensing model is mixed, with general troubleshooting access and licence-dependent telemetry and Copilot capabilities.
